items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: And most likely all the time it would be Charney would be with the Tuxedo band

ctx.x: I knew another left hand drummer in Chicago, Snaggs Jones. He left here very early though. Uh huh. Played with King Oliver, now way back. Oh yeah. He was left handed. Um, we were talking about some of your favorite drummers. Do you remember any others on parade that you used to like? Especially? If you'd follow on a parade?

Yeah, but most likely, under these fellas used to play, the parades could look like their band had the job, contract with the societies. That was the time, yeah. And most likely all the time it would be Charney would be with the Tuxedo band, and Alfred Williams, and Contra was with parades for last month. And the Bay was with the Hornwood band. Oh yeah. And all that sort of thing. I could remember that.
Do you remember the other Matthews brothers that played?
